notes: Fixed Tournament intro audio: Electron now permits audible autoplay and explicitly unmutes the game window.
Removed the old silent autoplay fallback that could make the bracket and Grand Finals intros play muted.
Both tournament intro videos now use normalized, louder audio while preserving the video visuals.
If a PC still blocks autoplay audio, a PLAY INTRO WITH SOUND button appears and restarts the intro with sound after one click.
Grand Finals still place the actual finalist student photos/images into the left and right character positions of the championship video.
